name: integer_sign
description: Name a displayed integer's sign as positive or negative, with matched parity naming control.
generator_code:
import json,random
random.seed(0)
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(100):
 n=random.randint(1,99)*(-1 if i%2 else 1)
 prefix=f'Integer: {n}. '
 items.append({'prompt':prefix+'Classify its sign. Choose positive or negative. Answer:', 'answer':' '+('positive' if n>0 else 'negative')})
 control.append({'prompt':prefix+'Classify its parity. Choose odd or even. Answer:', 'answer':' '+('odd' if n%2 else 'even')})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
